resources.string: How a logged-in visitor is named in the greeting. A visitor who is not logged in is greeted without a name.
Show the greeting in every headline
If this is enabled, the greeting is appended to the headline of every page. This is only meant to show that a plugin can change what Admidio produces.

An example plugin that shows every convention in one place: a manifest, an entry file that registers a hook, one page, one class, its own preferences and its own language file. A plugin needs none of that beyond the manifest and the entry file.
The text the plugin greets with.
This page belongs to the Hello World plugin. It is an ordinary Admidio module file that lives inside the plugin directory.
